description: Current balances in every currency plus Jars (savings). `amount` is what's available now; `reserved` (pending card payments) is already deducted from it, not extra money. Default: all profiles. Empty balances are hidden unless include_empty is true.

profile.description: Profile id, "personal", "business", part of the name, or "all" (default)

name: list_balances

amount.description: Available to spend or send now; reserved money is already taken out of it

reserved.description: Held for pending transactions (mostly card payments not settled yet). Already deducted from amount: not extra money

total_worth.description: Only when it differs from amount, e.g. invested balances

title: List Wise balances
